jobs.title: Graduate Engineering Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Quick answer: Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 hiring is happening through a pool campus drive in Ahmedabad on 12 December 2026 for BE/B.Tech graduates of the 2025 and 2026 batches. The job is in Micron’s Sanand assembly and test plant, the stated package is ₹5.50 LPA plus benefits, and shortlisted candidates hear back by email or WhatsApp on or before 7 December.

Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 — job details at a glance Company Micron Technology (Micron Technology Operations India) Role Graduate Engineering Technician (Assembly & Test) Drive type Pool campus drive, physical assessment Drive date 12 December 2026 Venue Ahmedabad, Gujarat (exact address not published; shared with shortlisted candidates) Job location Micron plant, Sanand, Gujarat Eligibility BE/B.Tech, 2025 and 2026 pass-outs, age 18+, no active backlogs Branches Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Mining, Industrial, Production, Metallurgy, Instrumentation Salary Stated on form: ₹5.50 LPA + benefits | Reported: ₹3–6 LPA (job listings); ₹5.5–7.7 LPA (AmbitionBox, Micron technicians, 4 reports) Selection Written test, then interview Organised by Cosmos Manpower Pvt Ltd (named as Micron’s recruitment partner); no fee

Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 – full job details

The Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 pool drive is a single-day hiring event for engineering graduates who want to start on the shop floor of a semiconductor plant. Candidates from several colleges register through one online form, the recruiter shortlists them, and only shortlisted people travel to Ahmedabad on 12 December 2026 for the written test and interview.

The registration form is run by Cosmos Manpower Pvt Ltd, which describes itself on the form as the recruitment partner of Micron Technology. The drive was also shared on LinkedIn by a member whose profile lists Micron. Selected candidates join Micron’s assembly, test, marking and packaging facility at Sanand, near Ahmedabad.

Branch filter: the form lists only Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Mining, Industrial, Production, Metallurgy and Instrumentation streams. Computer Science and IT are not on the list, and B.Sc, diploma and MCA candidates are not eligible for this drive.

Check before you register: the form asks for your Aadhaar number, Aadhaar address and CV, and records your Google account. It also offers a 2027 batch option even though the drive text says 2025 and 2026 only, so 2027 students should not expect a call. You must agree to shift work and relocation, and an active backlog found after selection cancels the offer. Micron and its partner charge no fee; never pay anyone for a slot.

What you will do in the Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 role

The form links a job profile document but does not spell out duties in its text. Based on how assembly and test plants run, a Graduate Engineering Technician at Sanand typically handles:

  • Running and monitoring production equipment on the assembly and test lines
  • First-level troubleshooting of machine alarms and escalating to engineers
  • Recording output, yield and downtime data in factory systems
  • Following cleanroom, ESD and safety rules on every shift
  • Supporting preventive maintenance and process checks

Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 eligibility

  • BE or B.Tech degree, 2025 or 2026 year of passing
  • One of the nine listed engineering streams
  • Age 18 years or above on the drive date
  • No pending or uncleared backlogs
  • Willing to work in rotating shifts and relocate to the Ahmedabad–Sanand area
  • Able to attend the 12 December assessment in person

For the Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 drive, a minimum CGPA is not stated. The form asks for your CGPA, so expect it to be used for shortlisting. Experienced candidates can register, but the role is pitched at freshers.

Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 selection process

The Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 process has two rounds named on the form. Shortlisting happens first, and the notice goes out on email or WhatsApp on or before 7 December 2026.

  1. Online registration — fill in the Google Form with your CV
  2. Shortlist — message by 7 December if selected
  3. Written test — expect aptitude, basic electrical and mechanical concepts, and English
  4. Interview — technical basics from your branch, shift readiness and communication

Expected salary for the Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 drive

In the Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 drive, the form states a package of ₹5.50 LPA plus benefits. For comparison, job listings for the same Sanand title show ₹3–6 LPA, and AmbitionBox shows ₹5.5–7.7 LPA for Micron technicians based on only 4 reports. Treat the reported figures as market estimates and ask for the CTC break-up in writing.

How to apply for Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026

  1. Open the official Micron pool campus drive registration form
  2. Fill in your name exactly as on Aadhaar, WhatsApp number and email
  3. Choose your stream, batch and CGPA honestly
  4. Upload your CV and confirm physical attendance on 12 December
  5. Submit, then watch email and WhatsApp until 7 December

Apply for Micron Graduate Engineering Technician 2026 →

About Micron Technology

Micron Technology is a US-based maker of memory and storage chips such as DRAM and NAND. Its Sanand unit in Gujarat assembles and tests memory products, which is why most fresher roles there are on the manufacturing floor and run in shifts.
